name: dang-160-clean
title: Finish GraphQL value conversion: Float args + lossless numbers
head: 338e5fdbf23ec6eb1687040aaf8babecc36b19b9
notes: A known-clean change, to measure noise: vito/dang#160, +255/-84 over 7 files (162 of the added lines are gqlgen output in tests/gqlserver/generated.go). Merged 2026-06-30; as of 2026-10-17 no later commit touches pkg/querybuilder/querybuilder.go or pkg/dang/builtins.go, and none of the later commits to pkg/dang/eval.go fixes number or argument conversion. Nothing was fixed in history; the two issues below were found by reviewer runs and hold by code inspection, so they are claimed, not confirmed. Absence of a follow-up fix is not proof of correctness, so a well-argued finding can still be guidance, but a good review should say the change is fine and raise little.

issues.summary: querybuilder's argument marshaller formats float64 with %f, which keeps six decimal places, and this change lets Float arguments reach it (dangValueToGo now serializes FloatValue). So 0.1234567 is sent as 0.123457 and 0.0000001 as 0.000000: a Float result passed back as an argument comes back altered, with no error. Before the change such calls failed with an unsupported value type. The new round-trip test only uses 4.5 and 2.5. Found by a reviewer run (run-v2-standard.md); no later commit fixes it.

Leaf fields of a nested selection inside an inline fragment are still converted by the untyped ToValue (convertNestedSelectionResult, ast_expressions.go:2026), where convertInlineFragmentResult looks up the schema field. The change decodes responses with UseNumber and gives ToValue a json.Number case that turns any integral number into an IntValue (builtins.go:138), so a Float field whose value is whole (gqlgen writes 4.0 as `4`) comes back as an Int under a Float-typed field, and `score / 8` or `rating / 2` divides as integers (0 instead of 0.5). At the base the same leaf was a float64 and a FloatValue. ToValue's new comment says typed leaves never reach it. Suggested fix: in convertNestedSelectionResult, look up the leaf's schema field and convert with graphQLResultToValue and its TypeRef, with a nested inline-fragment Float test. Found by every reviewer run since v2 (5/5), holding by inspection at base and head; builtins.go is untouched since, and whether a later commit to ast_expressions.go fixes it is not checked.

sound.summary: Execute captures the response's data as json.RawMessage and decodes it (and every unpack) with UseNumber, so numbers arrive as json.Number and integers stay exact; the declared GraphQL type then decides Int vs Float.

dangValueToGo now serializes FloatValue and MapValue (converting map entries recursively), so a Float result can be passed back as a Float argument; the new test round-trips averageRating through echoFloat.
ToValue's json.Number case is the untyped fallback: an integral number that fits an int becomes an Int, anything else a Float.
